attack_techniques: Steal or Forge Kerberos Tickets: Kerberoasting (T1558.003)
attackers_goals: Crack service account credentials by obtaining an easy-to-crack Kerberos ticket.
description: A user specifically requested weak and deprecated encryption in a Kerberos TGS request. This provides easy-to-crack hashes, and is typically a sign of a Kerberoasting attack. The requested service was specified by using a suspicious SPN type, which is often used by Kerberoasting tools to request by SAN instead of SPN.
investigative_actions: Check who used the host at the time of the alert to rule out a benign service or tool requesting weak Kerberos encryption.
name: Possible Kerberoasting without SPNs
required_data: Palo Alto Networks Firewall traffic Logs
